Title: One Fine Day

Cast

1. Vinod - 33 years, son
Look: light beard, green T-shirt
2. Meenakshi - 29 years, daughter
Look: green saree
3. Sonali - 30 years, friend
Look: green saree
4. Karan - 32 years, friend
Look: white kurta-pyjama
5. Pallavi - 62 years, mother
Look: yellow kurta, jeans

Places

1. The terrace - a water tank, a clothes line

Scene 1: The terrace - Day

[Vinod stands on the terrace. Pallavi, Meenakshi and Sonali stand near him.]

Pallavi: "Today feels like a good day."

[Vinod ties a letter to the pigeon and lets it fly.]

Vinod: "That's easy."

[Vinod reads the letter the pigeon brought.]

Meenakshi (softly): "That was such a fun day!"
